title: Data Scientist (Brazil) Rio de Janeiro
description:
place Oslo, Norway

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with a positive, team-oriented approach.
  • Ability to assess risk and recommend actions and strategies to mitigate regulatory risks.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently on multiple tasks to meet deadlines, prioritize, and maintain flexibility in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in tariff classification and country of origin determination. Engineering background in HTS Classification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of documentation requirements and Brazil Customs regulations.
  • Data analysis and Excel skills proficiency.
  • Brazil Customs Brokerage License not required, but highly desirable.
  • Impeccable ethics and trustworthiness.

Job description

Somos a Árvore, a plataforma gamificada de aprendizagem que semeia o prazer em aprender.

Atualmente, o Brasil é um dos países que menos lê no mundo. São menos de 3 livros anuais por habitante, e no PISA, Programa Internacional de Avaliação de Alunos, o nosso desempenho cai ano após ano.

Na Árvore, acreditamos que a leitura é um superpoder que facilita o aprendizado, ajuda no entendimento do mundo e potencializa as habilidades do século XXI.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para que cada vez mais alunos tenham acesso à leitura. Atualmente, já impactamos mais de dois milhões de alunos, e sabemos que podemos ir ainda mais longe.

Tecnologia e inovação fazem parte das nossas raízes. Jogamos junto com escolas e famílias no desafio de educar em um dia a dia ultraconectado.

Somos plurais e empáticos, nos adaptamos e encaramos os desafios do futuro com curiosidade e entusiasmo. Somos apaixonados por nossos clientes e comprometidos com resultados e entregas melhores todos os dias.

Com as nossas soluções, somos vencedores há 9 anos seguidos do prêmio Top Educação e 1ª startup brasileira a vencer o GESAwards, maior competição de Edtechs do mundo.

Aqui você vai encontrar um ambiente de crescimento, dinâmico e com aprendizados constantes.

Esse desafio faz sentido para você? Vem pra Árvore.


Main responsibilities

A Árvore está em busca de um Analista Contábil Pleno para fortalecer o time financeiro, com foco em contabilidade societária e fiscal. Essa pessoa será responsável por revisar lançamentos contábeis, tributos e encargos sociais, acompanhar as entregas do escritório de contabilidade terceirizado e assegurar conformidade com normas contábeis e fiscais. Além disso, dará suporte na organização de relatórios gerenciais e no relacionamento com auditorias externas, contribuindo para a confiabilidade das informações financeiras da empresa.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Revisar e validar lançamentos contábeis e fiscais, assegurando conformidade com normas contábeis, tributárias e políticas internas.
  • Acompanhar tributos e obrigações fiscais, garantindo prazos e qualidade das entregas junto ao escritório de contabilidade terceirizado.
  • Coordenar a comunicação entre times internos (Contas a Pagar, Faturamento, Departamento Pessoal e Logística) e a contabilidade externa.
  • Dar suporte em auditorias externas e processos de compliance, consolidando informações e acompanhando revisões.
  • Colaborar na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais (como DRE, Balanço Patrimonial e Fluxo de Caixa) e apoiar no monitoramento de orçamento e indicadores financeiros.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias e economias fiscais em conjunto com o escritório de contabilidade.
  • Apoiar a liderança do time financeiro em análises pontuais e projeções, contribuindo para a organização e confiabilidade das informações.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo .
  • Experiência prévia em contabilidade societária e fiscal , preferencialmente em revisão de lançamentos e tributos.
  • Conhecimento em CPC/IFRS (nível básico/intermediário, com possibilidade de aprofundamento no dia a dia).
  • Domínio de Excel para organização de relatórios e análises financeiras.
  • Capacidade de organização, atenção a detalhes e habilidade para lidar com múltiplos stakeholders.

Additional information

Seria bom se você também tivesse:

  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou educação.
  • Experiência com auditoria externa e/ou escritórios de contabilidade terceirizados.
  • Conhecimento em automação de processos financeiros e integração de sistemas (ERP, especialmente Protheus/Totvs).
  • Contato prévio com operações internacionais ou multinacionais.
  • Vivência em FP&A ou interface com investidores, como apoio a relatórios e análises financeiras.

title: Head of Distribution Sales, Americas
description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are excited to introduce a remarkable opportunity at Lonza as the Head of Distribution Sales, Americas. This position will be crucial in directing and leading our distributor network across North, Central, and South America. This is your chance to join a world-class team, contributing to outstanding growth and innovation at Lonza!

Key responsibilities:

  • Build and implement a comprehensive indirect sales approach for the Americas, emphasizing distribution and agency channels in line with global objectives.

  • Identify and capitalize on regional growth opportunities to increase revenue and market share through distribution.

  • Lead the channel partner selection process across the AMERs region and build a high-performing network of distributor sales professionals.

  • Foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the distributor and agent network, setting clear performance expectations and providing regular feedback.

  • Develop and implement channel programs to improve partner engagement and monitor distributor performance, offering insights and recommendations for improvement.

  • Lead the transition from conventional distributor relationships to a more strategic approach, backed by successful change management and adherence to Lonza CHI processes.

  • Collaborate with the Global Distribution Leader to improve global initiatives and oversight in the AMER region.

  • Collaborate with direct sales teams and internal stakeholders—including marketing, product management, and customer service—to ensure cohesive and aligned sales operations.

  • Oversee distribution contract negotiations and governance in close coordination with the global distribution leader.

  • Establish and manage key performance indicators to evaluate indirect sales outcomes and provide regular reports and insights to senior leadership on performance, white space, and growth opportunities.

  • Apply data-driven decision-making to continuously improve the distribution network.

Key requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required; Msc or MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

  • Strong understanding of principal-distributor dynamics in competitive and technical B2B environments.

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing sales strategies that boost revenue growth, especially with distributors and agents.

  • Analytical and data-driven approach, with expertise in analyzing sales analytics and reporting tools.

  • Willingness to travel within the region, up to 50%, as required.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
This position is based on a Cruise Ship

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.
  • Hold a current valid medical license.
  • Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.
  • Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.

Reports to: Spa Manager

Job Summary

The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to on onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures, safely and effectively, and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services, to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions, safely and effectively, to address the concerns of on board guests. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi–Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi-Spa Physicians if necessary. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to gain the knowledge of the spa services and products in effort to cross-promote these services to guests. The Medi-Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi – Spa Sales Consultant. Position requirements Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests Work closely with the Medi–Spa Sales Consultant Must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills Must be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi-spa services Enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality Excellent communication and listening skills Basic computer knowledge Must be a team player

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.
  • Provide consistent professional medi-spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld’s medi-spa protocols.
  • Conduct patient follow-up as required.
  • Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.
  • Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control
  • Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.
  • Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager’s office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years. (3 years on Cunard and P&O).
  • Cross-promote other spa services.
  • Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure. Properly clean and restock medi-spa treatment room as required.
  • Manage medical product and supply inventory.
  • Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention.
  • Handle guests’ questions and concerns professionally and courteously.
  • Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests.
  • Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment.
  • Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa.
  • Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings.
  • Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management.
  • Train new spa staff in medi-spa services/cross-promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions.
  • Follow Medi-Spa Operations Policies.
  • Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report.
  • For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service.
  • All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms. Doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest.
  • At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy. Conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them. Schedule a follow-up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk.
  • Clean your room and set up for your next guest.
  • Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest. This means the room must be:
  • Clean – sanitize work surfaces and sink area; store trash is proper receptacles.
  • biohazard/sharps/trash: All trash must be taken out daily or when full.
  • Organized – stock boxes should be out of sight and all supplies must be organized or stored properly
  • Inviting – the treatment bed must be properly dressed and proper ambience with regards to music and temperature. End of Day Checklist
  • Dispose of open unused needles
  • Dispose of Bio-Hazard bag if full
  • Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full
  • Sterilize table and countertops
  • Fill out inventory control form
  • Lock product storage cabinets
  • Lock treatment room
  • Email daily revenue report to shore side team
  • Service booking policy: A clean, non-intimidating, state-of-the-art and stress-free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. It will not only hurt the business of our spa but will affect your individual success in this industry. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention:
  • Medi-Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer.
  • In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services if you are not qualified to perform all services.
  • Medi-Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager’s approval. All staff members are required to perform general duties during their scheduled hours, as directed by the manager onboard. General duties may include, but are not limited to, promotional duties, port cleaning, staff meetings, training and stock inventory. Please be guided by your Spa Manager’s instructions. Guidelines for Protection and Sanitization (GPS)
  • Be familiar with OneSpaWorld’s ‘GPS’ to safety.
  • Understand and practice the required self-screening procedures.
  • Understand and follow the agreed upon procedures for symptomatic guests or employees.
  • Understand and adhere to staff and guest Physical Distancing Policy.
  • Understand and adhere to Staff Personal Hygiene Policy.
  • Understand and adhere to the Hand Washing Policy.
  • Arrive at the spa between five and ten minutes prior to assigned shift start time. Understand proper use and disposal of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the modality and for handling soiled linen, waste, and chemicals.
  • Be familiar with the approved disinfecting products available at the spa location including proper use, contact time, disinfection methods and proper storage and handling procedures.
  • Understand and adhere to the Treatment Room Preparation requirements.
  • Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable modality and services performed.
  • Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable spa area.
  • Understand the Sanitation Log Policy and complete logs as required.
  • Understand and adhere to the Retail Product Handling and Transferring Procedure.
  • Understand and adhere to the Product Sampling Procedure.

title: Maritime Sales Support Coordinator
description:
Your Mission

As a Sales Support Coordinator, you will support the Americas maritime sales team in achieving revenue and acquisition targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

The Inside Sales Coordinator reports to the Vice President of Sales, Americas. You will primarily support the Brazil-based sales team and occasionally assist the North American team.

Main Tasks

  • Support Key Account Managers with preparing sales proposals.
  • Quote and process less complex customer inquiries, such as for mobile satellite services (MSS).
  • Facilitate customer requests to the relevant departments for execution.
  • Act as a secondary contact for customers in the absence of the Key Account Manager.
  • Prepare, submit, and follow up on sales documentation, including contracts, change orders, vessel transfers, customer questionnaires, and portal management.
  • Assist customers with contract registration and manage onboarding processes.

Qualifications & Professional Skills

  • Successful experience in B2B sales support or inside sales environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish fluency is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications such as PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Dynamics CRM.
  • Experience in the maritime industry is preferred but not essential. Knowledge of satellite, network/IP technologies, or IT/telecommunications is advantageous.

Attitude & Interpersonal Skills

  • Structured approach to customer service and task management.
  • High commitment, energy, and enthusiasm for working with customers and internal teams.
  • Ability to take initiative and work independently.
  • Active sharing of information and knowledge within the organization.
  • Effective engagement with colleagues from diverse cultures and time zones.
  • Excellent listening and communication skills to understand customer needs.
  • Sense of urgency to support a 24/7 global customer base.

We Offer

  • Be part of a market-leading success story eager to further shape the industry.
  • Opportunity to gain expertise in sectors where Marlink operates.
  • Flexible hybrid work model with home office options.
  • Access to Marlink Training Academy for professional and personal development.

Sobre o Grupo Marlink

Marlink é líder de mercado nos setores de navegação, energia, mineração, humanitário e governamental. Projetamos, construímos e gerenciamos redes de tecnologia agnósticas, unificando serviços via satélite, terrestres e digitais em soluções confiáveis.

Nosso portfólio evoluiu para além da conectividade, oferecendo serviços totalmente gerenciados, incluindo redes, cibersegurança, TI e IoT. Entregamos possibilidades em qualquer lugar.

À medida que a Marlink continua a crescer, buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Suporte de Vendas para apoiar nossa equipe comercial na região das Américas, com foco principal na América Latina.

Sua Missão

Como Coordenador(a) de Suporte de Vendas, você apoiará a equipe de vendas marítimas das Américas para atingir metas de receita e aquisição, mantendo altos níveis de satisfação do cliente.

O Coordenador de Vendas Internas reporta-se ao Vice-Presidente de Vendas das Américas. Você dará suporte principalmente à equipe no Brasil, e ocasionalmente à equipe na América do Norte.

Principais Atividades

  • Apoiar os Gerentes de Contas-Chave na preparação de propostas comerciais.
  • Responder e processar solicitações de clientes menos complexas, como serviços móveis via satélite (MSS).
  • Encaminhar solicitações aos departamentos responsáveis para execução.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato secundário na ausência do Gerente de Contas-Chave.
  • Preparar, enviar e acompanhar documentação de vendas, contratos, ordens de alteração, transferências de embarcações, questionários de qualificação e portais.
  • Auxiliar no registro de contratos e gerenciar o onboarding de clientes.

Qualificações e Competências Profissionais

  • Experiência bem-sucedida em suporte de vendas B2B ou vendas internas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação em português e inglês; espanhol é desejável.
  • Familiaridade com aplicativos Microsoft, como PowerPoint, Word, Excel e Dynamics CRM.
  • Experiência na indústria marítima é preferencial, conhecimentos em tecnologias via satélite, redes/IP, TI/telecomunicações são diferenciais.

Atitude e Habilidades Interpessoais

  • Abordagem estruturada ao atendimento ao cliente e gestão de tarefas.
  • Comprometimento, energia e entusiasmo no trabalho com clientes e equipes internas.
  • Iniciativa e autonomia no trabalho.
  • Compartilhamento ativo de informações e conhecimentos.
  • Capacidade de envolver-se com colegas de diferentes culturas e fusos horários.
  • Ótimas habilidades de comunicação e escuta ativa.
  • Senso de urgência para dar suporte a uma base de clientes global 24/7.

Oferecemos

  • Participar de uma história de sucesso de liderança de mercado, com desejo de moldar o setor.
  • Oportunidade de adquirir expertise nos setores de atuação da Marlink.

Visão Geral

Como Analista Júnior de Modelagem Econômico-Financeira na Unir Projetos e Infraestrutura, você fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar dedicada à estruturação de concessões e Parcerias Público-Privadas (PPPs). Seu papel será construir modelos financeiros e relatórios técnicos que sustentam decisões estratégicas de projetos públicos em setores como iluminação, mobilidade, saneamento, entre outros.

Este cargo é ideal para quem deseja aplicar conhecimentos em finanças, economia ou engenharia em projetos com impacto social, atuando de forma colaborativa e orientada a resultados.

Você terá sucesso se demonstrar:

  • Raciocínio lógico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Domínio técnico intermediário de finanças aplicadas e Excel;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização;
  • Curiosidade sobre infraestrutura e serviços públicos;
  • Disposição para aprender com orientação e crescer tecnicamente.

Você será acompanhado por profissionais experientes e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver em projetos reais, com espaço para assumir responsabilidades crescentes.

Como este cargo se encaixa na organização

A Unir é uma consultoria especializada na estruturação e acompanhamento de projetos de concessão e PPPs. O(a) analista júnior integra nosso núcleo técnico e contribui diretamente para a produção de entregas essenciais à nossa atuação — modelagens financeiras, análises de viabilidade e relatórios que apoiam decisões de clientes públicos e privados.

Responsabilidades

  • Confeccionar, com orientação, modelos econômico-financeiros de projetos de concessão e PPPs;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos baseados em análise de fluxo de caixa e indicadores de viabilidade;
  • Coletar, organizar e atualizar dados operacionais e econômicos para os modelos;
  • Realizar simulações de cenários e testes de sensibilidade financeira;
  • Apoiar a equipe técnica em reuniões internas e apresentações para clientes.

Qualificações

  • Graduação concluída em Economia, Administração, Finanças, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Também serão considerados(as) candidatos(as) com graduação em andamento nos últimos semestres, desde que com boa base técnica e disponibilidade para atuação em tempo integral;
  • Domínio de Excel (inclusive fórmulas financeiras e organização de planilhas);
  • Capacidade analítica, organização e clareza na comunicação escrita;
  • Interesse em concessões, finanças públicas, infraestrutura urbana e políticas públicas.

Diferenciais desejáveis (não eliminatórios):

  • Noções de VPL, TIR, WACC, CAPEX/OPEX;
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem, mesmo que em projetos acadêmicos;
  • Familiaridade com temas de serviços públicos ou investimentos em infraestrutura.

Envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação (até 10 linhas), destacando sua motivação e qualificações mais relevantes, para com o assunto: Vaga Júnior – Modelagem Econômico-Financeira

title: SEO Content Manager
description:
Overview

We are looking for a Content Manager with strong SEO skills to contribute to the success of our top performing betting websites on the Brazilian market. The role is based in Brazil with offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.

About the role

As our content manager at Better Collective Brazil your key objective will be the coordination, production and optimization of content. You will become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team working in our offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Your key objective will be the coordination, production, and SEO optimization of high class content that ranks in Google. You will become part of an international, highly skilled and dedicated team catering to various user groups, in the broad field of sports betting and iGaming. You will take ownership and responsibility of the websites and products you are working on.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the production of content for several of our top websites and create editorial plan
  • Optimize content for SEO
  • Perform keyword studies and develop strategies to address different user groups
  • Create new content based on business and market priorities
  • Manage requests to freelancers/writers, proofread their work and provide feedback
  • Regularly monitor KPIs (rankings, traffic, conversion)
  • Keep an overview of legal and competitive changes on the market
  • Closely collaborate with our business development team in order to make sure we have the best deals in place with our partners
  • Make sure your products / sites have the best interface; you will be able to collaborate with our CRO/UX team to optimize and push engagement rate up
  • Make sure your sites are technically performing
  • Provide your own SEO insights to rank higher in Google

Qualifications

  • Familiar with betting and passionate about sports
  • Speak (and write) English fluently and Portuguese (native from Brasil)
  • Master’s degree within the fields of Digital Marketing, Communications, Digital Strategy etc.
  • Minimum 3 years relevant experience e.g. from a content role or in the field of digital marketing (including internships)
  • SEO editing skills, and flair for proofreading on a variety of topics
  • UX sensibility in web-products
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
  • WordPress CMS experience
  • Team player
  • Ability to handle multiple projects at once

What we offer

  • International environment
  • High responsibility job where you will be able to innovate
  • A varied everyday life in a fast-paced international business
  • A lot of great office perks such as snacks and social events
  • A professional yet casual working climate with very skilled, passionate and fun colleagues you can imagine
  • Hybrid policy
  • Wellhub Platform - Wellness Platform
  • GoFluent - Language Learning Platform

Hiring model: PJ

Your path to BC

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application.

About us

We are a global sports media group headquartered in Copenhagen, with 20+ offices around the world and more than 1100+ employees. With our talented employees at the forefront we want to conquer the sports media world and become the leading digital sports media group. We want to bring a unique lens to the world of sports, mixing premium content, proprietary tools, and in-depth analysis to make sports fans with something at stake, smarter about betting. For people that love sports, working at Better Collective is an opportunity to work on something you are passionate about and make work purposeful and fun. For those not into sports, a strong sense of sportsmanship is woven into the organisation, creating a collaborative, supportive, and fun environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We strongly believe that diversity of experience and perspective leads to a better environment and better products. We hire for cultural growth and welcome everyone, regardless of background, ethnicity, age, religion, political beliefs, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or other characteristics.

title: Senior Manager, Telecom
description:
Overview

The position is for the Senior Manager, Telecom at FIFA Women’s World Cup . FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties on the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Telecom services pertinent to the tournament and/or associated events within Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review Telecom Infrastructure design and ensure all aspects of the Telecom deliverables are implemented at venues and offices according to FIFA requirements: Broadcast Contribution Network, Event/Stadium/Offices/Legacy Networks, CATV/IPTV, Cabling, Mobile Network, Radio and Spectrum, Telephony (VoIP), Telecom Rate Card.
  • Actively participate in the scope definition, procurement liaison, supplier selection and onboarding of Telecom and Network suppliers
  • Lead the management of Telecom infrastructure build and implementation, ensuring timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and decommissioning of venues.
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient provision of Telecom services for FIFA Offices, Tournaments and Events at select FIFA Events.
  • Track the progress of Telecom Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Telecom Infrastructure projects and operations, according to IT governance and keep counterpart aligned.
  • Manage an international Team of Telecom Experts/Managers including remote personnel in other countries/time zones.
  • Liaise with and/or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to the delivery and support of Telecom Infrastructure are communicated to and well understood by all parties.
  • Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel.

Your Profile

  • University degree or similar higher education in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum experience of 8-10 years in Network (routing/switching/security/wireless technologies)
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex Telecom Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professionals
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Telecom Infrastructure Service, including infrastructure design and implementation, network integration and connectivity.
  • Broad understanding of Telecom Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events with sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of BCN, WAN/MAN/LAN, MPLS, VLAN, VoIP, CATV/IPTV, Multicast, Spectrum, Mobile Networks
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Aptitude for consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR/ ES/ GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some trips lasting 15 days or more
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

title: Pricing and Deal Desk Senior Analyst
description:
Overview

Pricing and Deal Desk Senior Analyst at VTEX — Join to apply for the role. VTEX is a global leader in digital commerce technology, providing innovative solutions for businesses seeking excellence in their online ventures. As part of the Pricing & Deal Desk team, you will help optimize pricing models and play a crucial role in strategic negotiations. You will provide essential support globally to various departments and teams, combining organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills to ensure smooth daily tasks and projects.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Thinking: Develop strategic, analytical, and creative approaches for revenue generation aligned with VTEX objectives.
  • Pricing Optimization: Conduct analyses to refine VTEX product pricing models, ensuring competitiveness and profitability.
  • Commercial Support: Collaborate with commercial teams, providing analytical support, insights, and data-driven decisions to enhance profitability in negotiations.
  • Price Management: Design and implement price management processes, considering strategic and day-to-day operational aspects, governance and business rules.
  • Monitoring and Optimization: Monitor product development, proposing price optimizations to maximize performance.
  • Project Leadership: Lead projects related to new pricing models for the company's key revenue streams.
  • Technical Expertise: Apply knowledge of the VTEX platform architecture to pricing strategies, revenue metrics, and negotiation, combined with pricing optimization initiatives to refine VTEX product pricing models for competitiveness and profitability.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in English and Spanish.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields.
  • Analytical and systemic thinking.
  • Interest and ease to learn new tools and concepts.
  • Strong organization and self-motivation.
  • Willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities.
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • At least 3 years of experience in the field.

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers efficiency and reduces maintenance for organizations modernizing their tech stack. We empower brands, distributors, and retailers with flexibility and comprehensive solutions to invest in what provides a clear business advantage and profitability. VTEX serves 2,600 global B2C and B2B clients with 3,500 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended December 31, 2023). For more information, visit VTEX has more than 1,700 employees across 18 locations in 12 countries across Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Profit-sharing
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Language scholarship: 80% subsidies for English, Spanish, and Portuguese courses
  • Free shipping on 1000+ VTEX stores
  • Reading incentive

title: Software Engineer, QA, Brazil - X Delivery
description:
Overview


Locations : São Paulo | Rio de Janeiro


Software Engineer, QA, Brazil - X Delivery at BCG X


Note: This position is based in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, within a 150km radius of the capitals.


What You'll Do


As a Software Developer in Test at BCG X, you will play a pivotal role in improving our software development lifecycle, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, robust software solutions. Assignments will range from short term Proof of Concepts/Minimum Viable Products to long term cases.



  • As a member of BCG’s X Delivery team, you will work with consulting teams on a diverse range of sophisticated topics

  • You will have the opportunity to leverage software development methodologies to deliver value to BCG's Consulting & BCG X (case) teams, BCG X Product teams and Practice Areas (domain) through the delivery of specialized knowledge in software development, and accelerated execution support

  • Collaborate with teams to gather requirements, specify, design, develop, deliver and support software solutions serving client needs

  • Provide technical support through deep understanding of relevant tools and processes to build high quality and efficient technology solutions

  • Work closely with development and product teams to identify and mitigate risks before software release

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts to validate software functionalities, performance, and reliability

  • Implement continuous integration (CI) and continuous deployment (CD) processes to streamline testing and deployment phases

  • Collaborate on software design reviews to ensure testability and best practices are incorporated early in the development process

  • Analyze test results, identify issues, and work with development teams to resolve them promptly

  • Stay abreast of the latest testing technologies and methodologies to continuously improve testing strategies and efficiency


Must-Have Technical Skills



  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, JavaScript, and familiarity with Unix/Linux environments.

  • Proficiency with Git and CI/CD tools (e.g., CircleCI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman).

  • Knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and the ability to write and debug SQL queries.


Job Requirements



  • Bachelor's / Master's in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English

  • Proven track record as a Software Developer in Test or similar role, focusing on automated testing in a dynamic development environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identify and resolve issue.


Quality Assurance Responsibilities



  • Understand and implement best-fit approaches to testing, ensuring that applications and new features work as expected.

  • Maintain knowledge base of manual and automated testing.

  • Create and execute reusable automated / manual test cases and translate business logic into project requirements.

  • Leverage technologies to support business needs to attain high reusability and maintainability of current and newly developed systems.

  • Understand available automation tools and how/when they should be used.

  • Write effective unit tests and integration tests to ensure high-quality software delivery.

  • In-depth understanding of Executing System and Regression Testing.

  • Awareness of performance testing tools in an Agile environment.

  • Work independently on quality / testing tasks with minimal direction.


Business Requirement Gathering And Collaboration



  • Establish credibility by thought partnering with highly demanding stakeholders / consulting teams on application development and delivery topics; drawing conclusions on a range of external and internal issues and dependencies.

  • Execute software testing approach and creating defined outcome; contributing to approach selection.

  • Assure proper sign-off before uploading materials into internal repository for reference; sanitizing confidential client content in marketing documents.

  • Contribute to team’s content & IP development.


Additional info


Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process.


Even if you don’t meet all these requirements, we encourage you to apply if this job description excites you.


Note: For this position, we are considering applicants from São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, including both the capital cities and the surrounding areas within a 150km radius of the capitals.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Página da Vaga | Coordenador(a) de Suporte Técnico
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Missão do cargo

Coordenar a equipe responsável por prover apoio técnico às unidades de produção, com equipe especializada, promovendo segurança e eficiência das operações. Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento da equipe e o desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o suporte técnico de segundo nível para equipamentos dinâmicos, sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação , realizando diagnósticos e troubleshooting em falhas complexas, embarcando esporadicamente para atendimento emergencial offshore e mantendo contato próximo com operações para alinhamento técnico contínuo.
  • Planejar e acompanhar ações corretivas e alternativas técnicas para falhas funcionais , atuando junto às equipes onshore e offshore, propondo soluções técnicas viáveis e apoiando na elaboração de planos de ação e priorização de recursos.
  • Atender chamados técnicos via Flow e Greendocs , analisando criticidade e urgência dos chamados, direcionando para resolução técnica adequada, registrando histórico e ações tomadas.
  • Participar de projetos nas fases FEL-1 , contribuindo com estimativas de custo e escopo técnico no EVTE e validando viabilidade de execução e integração com sistemas existentes.
  • Representar tecnicamente a área em situações críticas e emergenciais , participando de salas de guerra e interdições, elaborando respostas técnicas para órgãos reguladores e coordenando ações imediatas com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Gerenciar tecnicamente contratos e fornecedores , desenvolvendo memoriais descritivos (MD), acompanhando entregas pontuais e conformidade técnica, avaliando desempenho e propondo melhorias.
  • Elaborar e revisar TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation) de grandes equipamentos , definindo critérios técnicos de avaliação, comparando propostas de fornecedores, recomendando alternativas mais adequadas ao escopo do projeto.
  • Avaliar e implantar recomendações de segurança e mudanças técnicas , participando da gestão de mudanças, propondo execução de melhorias, garantindo conformidade com normas e diretrizes de segurança.
  • Manter a governança técnica de sistemas de dados offshore , gerenciando o PI System e demais sistemas de monitoramento, garantindo integridade e disponibilidade das informações, promovendo uso eficiente dos dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Gerenciar a governança de turbomáquinas , monitorando desempenho e confiabilidade operacional, garantindo disponibilidade dos ativos críticos, desenvolvendo padrões técnicos e estratégias de manutenção mais eficazes, propondo ações de melhoria, garantindo suporte técnico especializado.
  • Gerenciar OT (Operational Technology) , avaliando redes industriais e obsolescência, implementando medidas de segurança cibernética, garantindo integridade dos sistemas de automação.
  • Assegurar a integridade e conformidade legal dos sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações , realizando o licenciamento junto à ANATEL e CINDACTA, conduzindo inspeções de abrangência de sinal VHF/UHF e antenas, executando inspeções de abrangência sonora do sistema PAGA.

Formação acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (preferencialmente Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas)
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas técnicas ou de gestão será considerado um diferencial

Experiência prévia desejada

  • Diagnóstico e troubleshooting de falhas complexas em:
  • Equipamentos dinâmicos (ex.: turbomáquinas)
  • Sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de monitoramento como PI System
  • Familiaridade com redes industriais e tecnologia operacional (OT)
  • Gestão de contratos técnicos e fornecedores
  • Elaboração e análise de TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation)
  • Licenciamento e conformidade legal de sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações (ANATEL, CINDACTA)
  • Normas e diretrizes de segurança operacional
  • Inglês avançado

Processo seletivo

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO? Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você possa nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga. Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Overview

Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Você quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? Se sim, a Amazon pode ser a escolha de carreira certa para você. Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. As equipes de transporte da Amazon trabalham para garantir a entrega de pacotes para clientes em todo o mundo. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Líder de Time para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil para a nossa Delivery Station em Hidrolândia, GO.

Como líder de equipe, você supervisionará uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores – Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). A função envolve prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico, em um espaço colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que de uma grande empresa.

Responsabilidades

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega; trabalhar em turnos variados, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança na área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  • Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.
  • Envolver-se com funções de suporte e/ou outros departamentos para abordar problemas ou necessidades de indicadores de desempenho (ex.: readiness, 5S, segurança, treinamento).
  • Monitorar o andamento das rotas, identificar desvios e ajustar com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Conduzir reuniões, atribuir funções e trabalhar com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia e melhoria do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Focar em métricas e identificar causas raízes para impulsionar melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas para problemas complexos sem comprometer a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento/implementação de sistemas e processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações diárias; garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas e coordenar reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e na Amazon, conforme necessário.

Requisitos / Qualificações

  • Capacidade de liderar e treinar equipes; foco em resultados e KPIs.
  • Disposição para trabalhar em turnos 24-7, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Habilidade para prosperar em um ambiente rápido, ambíguo e colaborativo.
  • Engajamento com melhoria contínua, análise de métricas e resolução de problemas.
  • Uso de ferramentas de software e hardware para operações diárias;
  • Comunicação eficaz e capacidade de reportar status e questões a várias áreas.

Notas legais e Inclusão

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

  • Think big - you\'re inspired by ambitious solutions to big patient problems, you approach them from first principles and you have the determination to clear hurdles to get there.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience
description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Engineer, you will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients. In particular, you’ll be one of the key contributors in improving operational efficiency, building new features while capitalizing on standardized solutions. Working in close collaboration with both business and engineering teams within Carta, we navigate a unique and challenging product space that intersects with multiple domains including Cap Table Management, Fund admins, and various other teams.

The Team You\'ll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.

About You

You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:

  • You have 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.

description:
Job description


A pessoa Product Owner será responsável por definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantir alinhamento com a visão estratégica da empresa e mapear a jornada do cliente. Atuará como ponte entre stakeholders e o time de desenvolvimento, acompanhando sprints, validando entregas e tomando decisões ágeis para maximizar o valor entregue ao usuário.


Main responsibilities



  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, criando e mantendo uma lista clara e priorizada de funcionalidades, melhorias e correções que precisam ser desenvolvidas. A priorização deverá ser feita com base em critérios como valor de negócio, impacto no cliente, urgência e complexidade técnica.

  • Detalhar requisitos e funcionalidades sob a forma de histórias de usuário (user stories), fornecendo critérios de aceitação claros e compreensíveis para o time de desenvolvimento.

  • Garantir que o backlog esteja sempre refinado, constantemente atualizado com feedbacks do cliente e equipe, removendo itens obsoletos ou não mais relevantes.

  • Definir a visão do produto, articulada com as metas estratégicas da empresa e as necessidades do mercado.

  • Mapear a jornada do cliente, entendendo profundamente quem são os usuários, seus problemas e como o produto pode atender a essas necessidades ao longo da sua jornada.

  • Definir as entregas e marcos (milestones) ao longo do tempo, garantindo que haja uma estratégia clara de desenvolvimento e evolução do produto.

  • Negociar e alinhar as expectativas dos stakeholders internos e externos.

  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as partes: agir como o ponto central de comunicação entre os times técnicos, stakeholders e usuários, evitando mal-entendidos e desentendimentos.

  • Garantir que os objetivos das sprints sejam cumpridos, fornecendo feedback constante e eliminando possíveis impedimentos.

  • Avaliar cada incremento do produto desenvolvido pelo time, verificando se os critérios de aceitação foram cumpridos e se a entrega atende às expectativas do cliente e do mercado.

  • Ser ágil ao tomar decisões, tanto no que diz respeito a novas funcionalidades quanto à manutenção do escopo e à priorização de correções.

  • Balancear o que é tecnicamente possível com o que é economicamente viável, sempre levando em consideração o valor que será entregue ao usuário.


Requirements and skills



  • Experiência com gestão de backlog, priorização de funcionalidades e ciclo de vida do produto.

  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ágeis: Scrum, Kanban e outras metodologias ágeis.

  • Excel avançado.

  • Experiência em criação de histórias de usuário bem definidas, com critérios de aceitação claros e objetivos.

  • Experiência com negociação de prazos, funcionalidades e recursos, equilibrando as demandas do negócio com as limitações técnicas.

title: Especialista de Segurança Cibernética
description:
Resumo

Cria, revisa e implementa políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança da informação para garantir a proteção dos dados e o cumprimento de normas e regulamentos. Desenvolve diretrizes de segurança para o uso seguro de redes, sistemas e aplicações. Realiza análise de riscos de segurança, identificando ameaças, vulnerabilidades e impactos potenciais para a organização. Propõe e implementa controles de segurança que mitigam os riscos identificados. Realiza avaliações regulares de risco em novos sistemas, aplicativos e atualizações de software. Monitora constantemente os sistemas de TI para identificar atividades suspeitas ou não autorizadas. Implementa e monitora sistemas de detecção de intrusão (IDS) e sistemas de prevenção de intrusão (IPS). Lidera e coordena respostas a incidentes de segurança cibernética, como violações de dados, malware, ransomware e outros tipos de ataques. Investiga incidentes, identifica a causa raiz e recomenda ações corretivas. Cria relatórios pós-incidente e desenvolve estratégias de prevenção para evitar futuras ocorrências. Conduz avaliações regulares de vulnerabilidade e testes de penetração (pentesting) para identificar fraquezas nos sistemas. Gerencia e prioriza a correção de vulnerabilidades por meio da aplicação de patches e atualizações de segurança. Gerencia e monitora sistemas de controle de acesso, assegurando que os usuários tenham apenas os privilégios necessários para realizar suas funções. Implementa e administra soluções de autenticação multifator (MFA) e sistemas de gerenciamento de identidades. Participa do desenvolvimento, manutenção e exercícios do Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e Plano de Recuperação de Desastres para garantir a continuidade das operações em caso de incidentes. Seleciona, especifica, configura e mantém ferramentas e tecnologias de segurança, como firewalls, antivírus, VPNs, sistemas de proteção de endpoints, DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e outros.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Design de Arquitetura de Segurança;
  • Experiência em Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes;
  • Experiência em Teste de intrusão;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Segurança de Redes, Segurança de Aplicações e Segurança em Cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Criptografia, Gestão de Identidade e Acesso (IAM).

Formação

Superior Completo em Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA , Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

Interested in data privacy? Check out our policies on Privacy and CA Candidate Privacy.

description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. The Rio de Janeiro Office is searching for a Civil Engineer, preferably with a Master’s Degree in Structural engineering, with 2 to 4 years’ industry experience to perform design services. The ideal candidate should have worked as an intern/co-op or structural engineer in a team environment participating in the production and development of structural concepts, analysis and calculations, construction drawings, services and material specifications, construction support services, and field inspections.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Development of structural analysis, design and detailing of concrete, steel, and timber structures
  • Finite element static and dynamic structural modeling and analysis of structures
  • Assist Senior Engineers with the preparation of design concepts, specifications, schedules, quantity and cost estimates
  • Prepare design calculations and check calculations
  • Coordinate detailed plan details with engineers and drafting technicians
  • Participate in field inspections, reports prepartions and in projects of rehabilitation of waterfront structures
  • Works in cooperation with other disciplines on multi-discipline projects

Other duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s of Science in Civil Engineering is required
  • Master’s of Science in Structural Engineering as a differential
  • Entry level with related internship experience or up to 2 years of industry experience
  • Civil engineer Licence CREA-RJ
  • Familiarity with either AutoCad / MicroStation, SAP2000 and REVIT as a differential
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Please provide cover letter and resume when applying.

Working conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.
